body.name: FrontierHandle
body.def: Start the lower direction from the explicit two-parent windmills \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\). At \(W_3^{(2)}\) and degree \(d=4\), first compute reduced rational formulas for every structural and disturbance coordinate, exhaustive half-trek, instrumental-cutset, and auxiliary-cutset failure transcripts, and the exact monomial-basis matrix of \(m_{\zeta,S}\) with a displayed nonzero \(\dim C_4(S)\)-square minor for every \(S\in\operatorname{Reach}_4(W_3^{(2)})\) not containing \(\zeta_3\). Lift this audited instance to every \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\) by proving generic birationality and \(\mathfrak H_{\ell,d}(S)\ne0\) for the locked coordinate \(\zeta_{\ell}\) for every set \(S\) obtainable before \(\zeta_{\ell}\) by degree-\(d\) recursive adjunctions of any structural or disturbance coordinates. For the upper direction, control recursive elimination by mixed-component decomposition and the multigraded graph algebra of \(\phi_G\), and prove that its Hilbert bounds dominate the same recursive filtration.
